name: fn_citas_set_integrante_from_legacy
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_citas_set_integrante_from_legacy()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_id_cita_integrante uuid;
  v_id_usuario uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.id_cita_integrante IS NOT NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.id_grupo_cita IS NULL OR NEW.orden_integrante IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT ci.id_cita_integrante
  INTO v_id_cita_integrante
  FROM public.citas_integrantes ci
  WHERE ci.id_grupo_cita = NEW.id_grupo_cita
    AND ci.orden_integrante = NEW.orden_integrante
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_id_cita_integrante IS NOT NULL THEN
    NEW.id_cita_integrante := v_id_cita_integrante;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT cl.id_usuario
      FROM public.clientes cl
      WHERE cl.id_cliente = NEW.id_cliente
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    (
      SELECT u.id_usuario
      FROM public.usuarios u
      WHERE u.id_persona = NEW.id_persona_cliente
        AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND u.estado = true
      ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1
    )
  )
  INTO v_id_usuario;

  INSERT INTO public.citas_integrantes (
      id_grupo_cita,
      orden_integrante,
      rol_integrante_codigo,
      tipo_cliente_codigo,
      id_usuario,
      id_persona,
      id_cliente,
      contacto_nombre_snapshot,
      contacto_email_snapshot,
      contacto_telefono_snapshot,
      alias_integrante,
      created_at,
      updated_at
  )
  VALUES (
      NEW.id_grupo_cita,
      NEW.orden_integrante,
      CASE
        WHEN NEW.orden_integrante = 1 THEN 'titular'
        ELSE 'acompanante'
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN NEW.id_cliente IS NOT NULL OR v_id_usuario IS NOT NULL THEN 'autenticado'
        ELSE 'invitado'
      END,
      v_id_usuario,
      NEW.id_persona_cliente,
      NEW.id_cliente,
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(btrim(NEW.contacto_nombre), ''),
        NULLIF(btrim(NEW.alias_integrante), ''),
        'Cliente'
      ),
      NULLIF(lower(btrim(NEW.contacto_email)), ''),
      NULLIF(btrim(NEW.contacto_telefono), ''),
      NULLIF(btrim(NEW.alias_integrante), ''),
      COALESCE(NEW.created_at, now()),
      now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id_grupo_cita, orden_integrante)
  DO UPDATE
  SET updated_at = public.citas_integrantes.updated_at
  RETURNING id_cita_integrante
  INTO v_id_cita_integrante;

  NEW.id_cita_integrante := v_id_cita_integrante;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_desactivar_tarifas_base_de_servicio()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.activo = TRUE AND NEW.activo = FALSE THEN
    UPDATE public.servicios_tarifas
    SET
      activo = FALSE,
      updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id_servicio = NEW.id_servicio
      AND deleted_at IS NULL
      AND id_empleado IS NULL
      AND activo = TRUE;
  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

name: fn_marcar_no_show
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE public.fn_marcar_no_show(IN p_minutos integer DEFAULT 10, IN p_limite integer DEFAULT 500)
    LANGUAGE plpgsql
    AS $$
BEGIN
  WITH objetivos AS (
    SELECT id_cita
    FROM citas
    WHERE estado_cita_codigo IN ('confirmada','en_salon')
      AND llegada_real_at IS NULL
      AND inicio_at <= (now() - make_interval(mins => p_minutos))
      AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY inicio_at ASC
    LIMIT p_limite
  )
  UPDATE citas c
  SET estado_cita_codigo = 'no_show',
      no_show_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM objetivos o
  WHERE c.id_cita = o.id_cita;
END;
$$;

name: fn_points_estado_final_cita
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_estado_final_cita()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_estado text;
BEGIN
  SELECT ec.estado_cita_codigo
  INTO v_estado
  FROM public.estados_cita ec
  WHERE lower(trim(ec.estado_cita_codigo)) IN ('completada','atendida','finalizada')
  ORDER BY
    CASE lower(trim(ec.estado_cita_codigo))
      WHEN 'completada' THEN 1
      WHEN 'atendida' THEN 2
      WHEN 'finalizada' THEN 3
      ELSE 99
    END
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_estado IS NULL THEN
    v_estado := 'completada';
  END IF;

  RETURN v_estado;
END;
$function$

name: fn_points_materialize_expired_cycles
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_materialize_expired_cycles(p_id_cliente uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_cycle record;
  v_balance integer;
  v_total integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR v_cycle IN
    SELECT pc.id_cycle, pc.id_cliente, pc.vence_at
    FROM public.points_cycles pc
    WHERE pc.estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo'
      AND pc.vence_at <= now()
      AND (p_id_cliente IS NULL OR pc.id_cliente = p_id_cliente)
  LOOP

    -- FIX CRÍTICO:
    -- points_transactions.puntos YA tiene el signo aplicado por trigger.
    -- NO se debe multiplicar otra vez por tipos_puntos.signo.
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pt.puntos), 0)::integer
    INTO v_balance
    FROM public.points_transactions pt
    WHERE pt.id_cycle = v_cycle.id_cycle;

    IF v_balance > 0
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.points_transactions pt
        WHERE pt.id_cycle = v_cycle.id_cycle
          AND pt.tipo_puntos_codigo = 'vencimiento'
      )
    THEN
      INSERT INTO public.points_transactions (
        id_cliente,
        id_cycle,
        tipo_puntos_codigo,
        puntos,
        vence_at,
        motivo,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      )
      VALUES (
        v_cycle.id_cliente,
        v_cycle.id_cycle,
        'vencimiento',
        v_balance,
        v_cycle.vence_at,
        'Vencimiento automatico del ciclo',
        now(),
        now()
      );
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.points_cycles
    SET estado_ciclo_codigo = 'expirado',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id_cycle = v_cycle.id_cycle
      AND estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo';

    v_total := v_total + 1;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN v_total;
END;
$function$

        created_at,
        updated_at
      )
      VALUES (
        v_cycle.id_cliente,
        v_cycle.id_cycle,
        'vencimiento',
        v_balance,
        v_cycle.vence_at,
        'Vencimiento automatico del ciclo',
        now(),
        now()
      );
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.points_cycles
    SET estado_ciclo_codigo = 'expirado',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id_cycle = v_cycle.id_cycle
      AND estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo';

    v_total := v_total + 1;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN v_total;
END;

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_trg_otorgar_puntos_por_cita()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_estado_final text;
  v_origen text;
  v_puntos_por_cita integer := 1;
  v_cycle record;
  v_cliente_usuario uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT public.fn_points_estado_final_cita() INTO v_estado_final;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF NEW.estado_cita_codigo IS DISTINCT FROM v_estado_final THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
  ELSIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    IF NOT (
      OLD.estado_cita_codigo IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.estado_cita_codigo
      AND NEW.estado_cita_codigo = v_estado_final
    ) THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
  ELSE
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.id_cliente IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  v_origen := CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(NEW.orden_integrante, 1) > 1 THEN 'integrante'
    ELSE 'titular'
  END;

  IF COALESCE(NEW.es_canje_recompensa, false) IS TRUE AND v_origen = 'titular' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(pr.puntos_por_cita, 1)
  INTO v_puntos_por_cita
  FROM public.points_rules pr
  WHERE pr.activo IS TRUE
    AND (pr.id_sucursal = NEW.id_sucursal OR pr.id_sucursal IS NULL)
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN pr.id_sucursal = NEW.id_sucursal THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    pr.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,
    pr.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_cycle
  FROM public.fn_points_get_or_create_active_cycle(
    NEW.id_cliente,
    COALESCE(NEW.inicio_at, now())
  )
  LIMIT 1;

  SELECT c.id_usuario
  INTO v_cliente_usuario
  FROM public.clientes c
  WHERE c.id_cliente = NEW.id_cliente
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  LIMIT 1;

  INSERT INTO public.points_transactions (
    id_cliente,
    id_cita,
    id_cycle,
    id_sucursal_origen,
    tipo_puntos_codigo,
    origen_punto_codigo,
    puntos,
    vence_at,
    motivo,
    creado_por_usuario_id,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  VALUES (
    NEW.id_cliente,
    NEW.id_cita,
    v_cycle.id_cycle,
    NEW.id_sucursal,
    'acumular',
    v_origen,
    GREATEST(1, COALESCE(v_puntos_por_cita, 1)),
    v_cycle.vence_at,
    CASE WHEN v_origen = 'integrante'
      THEN 'Punto por acompañante en visita completada'
      ELSE 'Punto por visita completada del titular'
    END,
    COALESCE(NEW.creada_por_usuario_id, v_cliente_usuario),
    now(),
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_validar_paquete_activo_minimo_servicios()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_id_paquete uuid;
BEGIN
  v_id_paquete := COALESCE(NEW.id_paquete, OLD.id_paquete);

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.paquetes p
    WHERE p.id_paquete = v_id_paquete
      AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND p.activo = TRUE
      AND (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM public.paquetes_detalles pd
        JOIN public.servicios s
          ON s.id_servicio = pd.id_servicio
        WHERE pd.id_paquete = p.id_paquete
          AND s.activo = TRUE
          AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      ) < 2
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'El paquete activo debe tener al menos 2 servicios activos';
  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_validar_paquete_activo_sin_servicios_inactivos()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_id_paquete uuid;
BEGIN
  v_id_paquete := COALESCE(NEW.id_paquete, OLD.id_paquete);

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.paquetes p
    JOIN public.paquetes_detalles pd
      ON pd.id_paquete = p.id_paquete
    JOIN public.servicios s
      ON s.id_servicio = pd.id_servicio
    WHERE p.id_paquete = v_id_paquete
      AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND p.activo = TRUE
      AND (s.activo = FALSE OR s.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'El paquete activo no puede contener servicios inactivos';
  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

name: fn_validar_servicio_activo_con_tarifa_base
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_validar_servicio_activo_con_tarifa_base()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_id_servicio uuid;
BEGIN
  v_id_servicio := COALESCE(NEW.id_servicio, OLD.id_servicio);

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.servicios s
    WHERE s.id_servicio = v_id_servicio
      AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND s.activo = TRUE
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.servicios_tarifas st
        WHERE st.id_servicio = s.id_servicio
          AND st.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND st.activo = TRUE
          AND st.id_empleado IS NULL
      )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'El servicio activo debe tener una tarifa base activa por sucursal';
  END IF;

  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_es_admin_de_sucursal(p_uid uuid, p_sucursal uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    public.fn_is_super_admin(p_uid)
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM roles_usuarios ru
      JOIN roles r ON r.id_rol = ru.id_rol
      WHERE ru.id_usuario = p_uid
        AND ru.activo = true
        AND r.nombre = 'admin'
        AND ru.id_sucursal = p_sucursal
    );
$function$

        AND ru.activo = true
